note: Part 2 archive contains 10 pages, but their core mechanics duplicate Part 1 games (including Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Four, Reversi, 2048, Snake, Pong, Breakout, Checkers, Mahjong-style matching, and Sudoku). They are retained for cumulative file history but excluded from the zero-repeat game catalogue.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Take turns placing X and O. Make a row of three to win.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: Connect Four
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Drop discs into columns; connect four horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: Reversi
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Place a disc to bracket and flip your opponent’s discs. Most discs wins.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: 2048 Merge
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Slide tiles with arrow keys or swipe. Merge equal numbers to reach 2048.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: Snake Classic
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Eat the food to grow. Avoid walls and your own tail. Arrow keys or swipe.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: Pong Duel
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Move your paddle with mouse, touch, or up/down arrows. First to 5 wins.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: Brick Breaker
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Control the paddle and bounce the ball to clear every brick.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: Memory Match
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Flip cards and find all matching pairs using visual memory.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: Checkers
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Move diagonally, jump opposing pieces, and promote pieces reaching the far edge. Two-player local game.

archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.title: Sudoku Mini
archived_entries_not_counted_as_unique.description: Complete the 9×9 Sudoku grid. Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain 1–9.
